overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: one chair's private conversation with a proponent was on his own initiative, and no quorum deliberated outside a meeting.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged a quorum of the Board deliberated about a proposed Town Common fountain outside a noticed meeting, based on a statement made at a public meeting.
allegations.key_passage: based on our review, we find no evidence that the Board actually deliberated outside of a meeting in violation of the Open Meeting Law.
